cases.about: From the kitchen's own onboarding document: Day 1 is a welcome and the safety sheet, the accounts and equipment it names (and one typical item marked to check), and two reminders for the hirer due the working day before the start. No account is created and no one is emailed.

## Day 1
Meet Ana (operations director); read the kitchen safety sheet; task: walk the kitchen and find every fire exit.
## Day 2
Meet your team lead; read the menu; task: prep one lunch dish with them.

## Accounts and equipment
- Rota app account
- Whites and a locker key
- Payroll form (typical — check)

## Before they start
- Set up the rota app account — by Fri 13 Nov
- Order whites in their size — by Fri 13 Nov
